title: Familiar knowledge and another free question
meaning: Established principles can give your shared view an inspiring direction and freedom to ask another question without a ready answer.
text: A familiar principle can restore simple curiosity about something that seemed understood already. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna suggests discussing experience through established knowledge. The Star in energy supports an inspiring honest understanding. The Fool in emotions responds with freedom for another question. You enjoy seeing an opportunity for inquiry before a finished answer is needed.

For example, you read about how symbols work and examine a familiar park diagram. One sign becomes a question: why was it placed here? **Shared knowledge can give freedom to see the familiar for the first time.** Automatic reading becomes interest in what a diagram shows and what it leaves outside. A learned principle helps name the question. Hope for an interesting discovery meets the lightness of not knowing. You can imagine together while distinguishing foundations, enjoying a small puzzle and attending to what the material actually depicts.

The risk is making pleasure in fresh questions a need to seek unusual explanations constantly. A simple account begins to feel insufficiently interesting. An honest inspiring direction stays connected with material. Sometimes an ordinary answer still clarifies an important detail. Free inquiry allows that too, leaving another question value of its own without requiring it continually to surprise both of you.
